# Brief

A tiny two-electrode seizure flag for a behind-the-ear patch. Keep the whole run small and quick: a small synthetic dataset (4 to 6 patients, a few hours each, 2 EEG channels), exactly three tiny candidate designs (for example a line-length threshold, an energy threshold and a 2-feature logistic or small integer model), each compiled and verified with the chip lab. Docker is not available here, so skip layout and timing-power.
